name: ShowSky_2
short_caption: The robot sweeps its left arm outward and upward, pointing high toward the sky to guide the viewer's gaze.
movement_description: The robot begins in a neutral posture and raises its left arm in a broad outward sweep to the left, with the hand opening up and pointing toward the upper-left quadrant. At the same time, its head tilts slightly up and to the left, tracking the direction of the hand. The right arm lifts slightly off the side in a loose counter-balance, and after holding the upward-pointing pose for a moment, both arms and the head smoothly return to the starting neutral position.
safety_notes: The left arm sweeps wide to the side and upward; ensure there is clearance to the left of the robot's upper body.
